name: tiff-viewer
description: Open TIFF and GeoTIFF files in VS Code. Multi-page stacks, 16-bit and float data with auto contrast, pixel values, tags and PNG export. Offline.

tiffViewer.maxFileMB.description: Files up to this size are decoded. Larger files show a message and the tags of every page, without pixels.

tiffViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used TIFF Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with TIFF Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Look at TIFF stacks, 16-bit and float data and GeoTIFF rasters without leaving VS Code.

steps.title: Open a TIFF file
steps.description:
Click a .tif or .tiff file in the Explorer. Multi-page files show a page strip on the left.
[Find a TIFF file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.tif%22%5D)

media.altText: A 16-bit microscopy TIFF in TIFF Viewer with auto contrast, a pixel value and the tags panel.

steps.title: Pick a channel and a contrast stretch
steps.description: Use View to show one channel or the RGB composite, and the stretch menu for percentile, min to max or the full type range.

steps.title: Read GeoTIFF tags and coordinates
steps.description: The tags panel lists the CRS, pixel size, bounds and nodata value. The status bar shows map coordinates under the pointer.

steps.title: Large files and export
steps.description:
Export PNG saves the page as shown. Files over the size limit show their tags only.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22tiffViewer%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
